name: InspectorToggle
description:
Shows or hides the inspector pane: in Glass UX, the assistant for the current context. It is
pressed while the pane is open. Renders nothing when the page has no inspector.
signature: ({ icon, label, shortcut, }: InspectorToggleProps): import("react").JSX.Element | null

props.name: icon
props.description: The pane's mark (the product's AI mark). Default: the inspector glyph.

props.name: label
props.description: Its name and tooltip: "Assistant here". Default: "Show inspector" / "Hide inspector".

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Toggles from anywhere ("mod+."); shown in the tooltip.
